Why should pineapples not be allowed to join political parties?

Because political parties generally require members to be legal persons who can understand policies, make choices, and cast votes. Pineapples, despite their strong opinions on pizza, lack citizenship, consent, and the ability to fill out membership forms without getting juice on them.
